messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to announce the 'Optimize' release next Tue (9am PT). Need engineering sign-off on: final changelog, docs permalinks, canary rollout window, and an embeddings benchmark blurb for the blog. who can take ownership for each?

alex: I can take changelog + short API diff. will open the PR tonight. link when ready.

tao: I’ll handle docs links — need final anchor names from the doc side. ping @sophie if we rename any headings.

sophie: ok — docs team will freeze headings by EOD Mon. Tao, send the doc paths you want and I’ll add stable permalinks. we should use /docs/release-notes#optimize-1-3 style anchors.

maria: marketing needs the exact doc URLs for the announce post and the CTA buttons (webinar signup + changelog). also want a one-paragraph benchmark summary we can paste into the blog.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/214 — includes bullet list + minimal examples. still need to confirm performance numbers (tokens/sec) from perf tests.

tao: docs paths I want: /docs/inference/optimize, /docs/benchmarks/embeddings. will add redirects if headings change.

jordan: webinar team here — landing page draft ready. need final announce time + speaker list. also need a recommended 280-char tweet and 2-3 email subject variants.

maria: speakers: alex for changelog + eng details (10min), tao for docs/usage (8min), jordan for customer impact + CTA (7min). total 30min + q&a. webinar window proposed same day, 1pm PT.

tao: canary rollout: eng prefers a staged rollout starting 11am PT, 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 hrs with automatic rollback on error rate > 0.5%. is that ok for marketing?

maria: that's fine — we’ll schedule the announce at 9am PT, then show 'available to all' after 1pm with webinar at 1pm. note: social + email will go out at 9am. docs & changelog links must be live by 8:50am.

alex: perf numbers: embedding latency 45ms median, throughput 1.8k tokens/s on a40 baseline — running one more confirm job now, will push results into PR (tests/benchmarks/optimize-1-3.json).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment for release/optimize-1.3 at 11:00 PT on 2026-04-07. Monitors: error-rate, tail-latency, memory.

sophie: links will be available. final permalinks: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/optimize#v1-3 and https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-embeddings. I’ll add canonical meta tags.

maria: marketing checklist for EOD Mon: 1) changelog PR merged (alex) 2) doc permalinks live (sophie/tao) 3) benchmark blurb (alex) 4) webinar page ready + speakers confirmed (jordan) 5) UTM params for campaign (maria).

alex: changelog PR merged — commit 7a9f2b. perf numbers uploaded to PR.

tao: docs permalinks live and redirects in place. confirmed anchors.

jordan: webinar page published: https://redwood.ai/events/optimize-launch — speakers + CTA in place. added signup integrations to HubSpot.

maria: draft tweet: "Redwood Optimize v1.3 — faster, cheaper inference with smarter batching. Join our launch webinar 4/7 1pm PT. Sign up: https://redwood.ai/events/optimize-launch #LLM #inference" — any edits?

sophie: looks good. suggest adding an image with bench chart. Jordan can we upload to socials?

jordan: will upload images and schedule posts across X/LinkedIn at 9:00am PT. email blast queued for 9:05am PT with UTM tags utm_campaign=optimize_v1_3.

maria: final note — please add a short one-paragraph customer-facing benchmark line to the changelog PR so marketing can copy/paste. alex, Tao: can you add?

alex: added paragraph: "On our standard A40 baseline, embeddings see 1.8k tokens/sec and median latency of 45ms, reducing per-query cost by ~22% versus v1.2."

maria: perfect. thanks everyone — will confirm roll at 9am Tue and send final Slack ping 30m prior to announce. :rocket:
